# Motion Poster

A free, browser-based animated display for galas, fundraisers, parties, and venue screens. It replaces a static slide or paper poster with a living poster: a themed frame, drifting particles (petals, snow, confetti, steam), the event title, a host or sponsor list, and QR codes. Nothing to install and no account needed; everything runs in the browser and is saved locally.

Site: https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/
App: https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/app/
Help Center: https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/
Remote controller: https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/remote/

## What it does
- 30 animated themes in five packs (Standard, Party, Decades, Specialty, Holiday) with 276 built-in color schemes. Link to a theme directly with `/app/?theme=<id>`, for example `/app/?theme=art-deco-gala`.
- Editable event text, logo upload, and two QR code areas (upload an image, or generate a styled code from a URL).
- A host list that auto-scales to fit the screen, with add, remove, and restore.
- Wireless remote: press W on the poster, scan the QR code or enter the pairing code on a phone or tablet on the same network, and edit everything live.
- Built for events: screen wake lock, automatic recovery after a refresh or power blip, adjustable particle physics and frame rate.
- Private by design: no accounts, no tracking database. Settings, names, logos, and QR images are stored in the browser's local storage.

## Guides
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/getting-started/ : Launch, go fullscreen, and set up in five minutes
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/themes/ : All themes, packs, and direct links
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/customizing-appearance/ : Particles, layout, colors, and performance
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/editing-poster-content/ : Text, logos, and QR codes
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/managing-hosts/ : Add, remove, and restore names
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/remote-control/ : Pair a phone or tablet
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/keyboard-shortcuts/ : Every hotkey and touch trigger
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/running-your-event/ : Pre-event checklist and reliability features
- https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/docs/troubleshooting/ : Fixes and FAQ

## Key shortcuts
F fullscreen, Q controls, C customize appearance, E edit text, A add or remove names, W wireless remote, ? help, Esc close.
